title: Sharing Tasks Among Three
src: Media.net OA, IIT Patna. Coding question 3 of 3.
body:
You and two friends, Tom and Jerry, have A distinct tasks. Each task must go to at least one of the three of you, and a task may also go to two of you or to all three.

You must end up with exactly B tasks, Tom with exactly C and Jerry with exactly D. Count the ways to assign the tasks, modulo 109 + 7.

Function to complete

Complete countAssignments(A, B, C, D). It returns the number of assignments modulo 10^9 + 7.

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.
out: One integer: the number of assignments modulo 10<sup>9</sup> + 7.

wrong.why: forgets that every task needs someone: C(A,B)·C(A,C)·C(A,D)
assumes nobody shares a task (B + C + D must equal A)

samples.ex: Each person takes a different task: 3! = 6 ways.
One task is shared by two people and the other goes to the third. Choose who works alone (3) and which task is theirs (2): 6 ways.
